recipe.title: Assign distributor trailers to loading doors
recipe.scenario: Three trailers overlap at 08:30. Choose a compatible, available loading door for each trailer and keep doors exclusive during this interval. Prefer Door 7 for Parcel outbound because it is near the parcel staging area. This example does not choose arrival slots, sequence work, route trucks, or schedule crews.

field.name: assigned-doors
field.description: For a feasible plan, one door index per load in input order. The example preference yields 0,1,2.
